Platform.CPU: 600 MHz (underclocked to 500 MHz) Texas Instruments OMAP 3430 (ARM Cortex A8 + PowerVR SGX)

Battery.Battery: 3.7 V 1150 mAh, Internal rechargeable removable lithium-ion battery
